Definition: properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion)
BiblicalUsage: Nuts means to flash out, to blossom, or to fly away. In Song of Solomon 6:11 the lover goes down to see whether the vine has flourished and the pomegranates have budded, and in Lamentations 4:15 the same word is the people fleeing away and wandering among the heathen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same quick motion can mean blossoming or fleeing, and the difference is whether the Lord is tending the garden or judging it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
